title: room.joined
description: server → client. Confirms the join and hands out the reconnect token. The phone stores room and token in sessionStorage. The snapshot follows.

id.description: PlayerId when `kind` = PLAYER, SpectatorId when SPECTATOR.

slot.description: Seat number for players; null for spectators.

nickname.description: Nickname after normalisation; null for spectators who gave none.

spectatorReason.description: Why the member is a spectator; null for players.

pendingPlayer.description: True when the spectator will be promoted to player at the next vote round (see `room.promoted`).

MemberKind.description: Membership kind of a phone connection.

Nickname.description: Display nickname after server normalisation (NFC, trimmed, inner whitespace collapsed): 2–16 characters; Unicode letters, digits, space, underscore and hyphen; first and last character must be a letter or digit.

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).

RoomCode.description: Room code: exactly 4 upper-case letters from A–Z without I and O (24-letter alphabet). Clients upper-case user input before sending.

SpectatorId.description: Spectator identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "s" followed by a positive integer.

SpectatorReason.description: Why a joiner was made a spectator.

Token.description: Opaque reconnect token issued by the server (URL-safe, 16–64 characters). Stored in the browser sessionStorage (phones) or host persistent storage. Never shown on screen.
